I looked at three homes worth over $100 million each and one of them is technically larger than Manhattan.

This week I've got a $157 million Palm Beach mansion with $8,000 crane statues and no safety railings by the water, a $400 million LA estate that spared no expense on gold bathrooms but somehow combined the tennis and basketball courts, and a $125 million upstate New York property with 36,000 acres, 80 miles of private road, and the most photogenic deer I have ever seen. There is also a dog on Zillow that I need to discuss. I need to take a break from these.
